facts.activity_file: removing isolation and returning to operations

mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: gravity release during commissioning of replacement equipment on CV-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on CV-3100 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically removing isolation and returning to operations. CV-3100 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was in place but did not perform. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 29 July 2018 an incident occurred on CV-3100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment, releasing gravity energy held as suspended load.
